card.name: Linking words before treatment or interaction terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or marks such as in, during, substrate, or an opening parenthesis in drug-label sentences about interactions, vaccines or pregnancy. It sits just before a treatment or drug-exposure phrase.

modes.label: CYP enzyme substrate
modes.description: The word substrate after a CYP enzyme name, in interaction statements.
modes.example: Sotorasib is a CYP3A4<< substrate>>. Coadministration of LUM

modes.label: Linking word before therapy
modes.description: Words like in or during that lead into receiving or being on a treatment.
modes.example: vaccination with live vaccines is not recommended<< during>> treatment with VYVGART HYTR

modes.label: Inside cyclosporine
modes.description: The middle of the drug name cyclosporine in a vaccine-interaction heading.
modes.example: During treatment with cyc<<lo>>sporine, vaccination may be less
